item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Imran builds a Sierpinski Triangle as in the diagram. He starts with one filled equilateral triangle. At each step he joins the midpoints of every remaining filled triangle and removes the open middle triangle.

After step $1$, how many filled triangles remain?

options.A: $1$, keeping the original triangle together with the middle piece.
options.B: Removing the middle is what creates the midpoints on the sides.
options.C: $3$, because joining the midpoints makes four congruent small triangles and the open middle is removed.
options.D: Count holes with the Sierpinski Carpet square-hole rule instead of midpoint removal on triangles.
